description: Source code implementing a traverser that rewrites atomic function expressions in an AST for shader translation, specifically simplifying atomic operations for HLSL translation.

classes.name: RewriteAtomicFunctionExpressionsTraverser
classes.description: AST traverser that rewrites atomic function expressions into simpler forms for shader translation.

methods.name: RewriteAtomicFunctionExpressionsTraverser
methods.description: Constructor initializing the traverser with symbol table and shader version.

methods.name: rewriteAtomicFunctionCallNode
methods.description: Rewrites a specific atomic function call node into an assignment with a temporary variable.

methods.name: getTempVariable
methods.description: Creates and returns a temporary variable of a given type.

methods.name: IsAtomicExchangeOrCompSwapNoReturnValue
methods.description: Checks if a node is an atomic exchange or compare-and-swap with no return value.

methods.name: IsAtomicFunctionInsideExpression
methods.description: Determines if an atomic function is used inside an expression.

methods.name: visitAggregate
methods.description: Visits aggregate nodes to process atomic functions.

methods.name: visitBlock
methods.description: Visits block nodes to insert temporary variables.
